subject: Partner paper sign-off: signer matrix & pass-through evidence request
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudmarket.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19 09:02 -0700
Subject: CloudMarket partner paper v3 + signer matrix

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for working through the partner paper changes with us. Attached is CloudMarket_PartnerPaper_v3.docx with our latest redlines and the seller_signer_matrix.xlsx that shows the roles we typically require for marketplace listings (legal, finance, marketplace ops).

Two asks from our side so we can move to DocuSign and marketplace enablement:
- Can Redwood confirm the signer matrix (who at Redwood will sign MSA vs Order Form vs marketplace listing addenda)?
- We also need evidence for pass-through billing and auditability — SOC2 type, KMS proof for customer key handling, and a one-page invoicing trace (how invoices flow from CloudMarket->reseller->end-customer).

If you can send a short note confirming signers and any evidence you can provide this week, we can schedule signature and aim for a July 24 listing.

Attachments (stubs):
- CloudMarket_PartnerPaper_v3.docx (redline)
- seller_signer_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudMarket
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudmarket.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19 10:17 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMarket partner paper v3 + signer matrix

Sophie —

Thanks for sending these along. Quick responses and next steps from our side: 

1) Signer matrix: Ben (sales ops) will draft an internal proposed matrix and confirm who is authorized to sign each document type. High level: 
   - MSA: General Counsel approval (Laura) or delegate
   - Marketplace addenda / Order Form: VP Partnerships (Marissa) + Finance sign-off for pass-through billing (Rishi)

2) Evidence: Laura, can legal confirm whether redlines to pass-through clauses are acceptable from a risk perspective (indemnity carve-outs, audit scope)? Rishi — please provide available SOC2 report link and a KMS ownership note. Ben — can you pull a one-page billing flow diagram we can share?

We want to keep the edit to partner paper minimal where possible and use a separate short addendum to capture billing pass-through specifics. If you (Sophie) are fine, we’ll propose DocuSign recipients after internal quick sign-off. Target internal sign-off by EOD 7/20 to hit CloudMarket’s 7/24 goal.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMarket partner paper v3 + signer matrix

Jasmine / team —

Attaching a quick sketch of the billing flow (billing_flow_diagram.png) and a sanitized orderform template (orderform_template.pdf) for CloudMarket review. High-level notes:

- For pass-through fees we currently support 'gross-fee pass-through' where CloudMarket charges end customers and invoices Redwood for our reseller-relevant commission reconciliation. Our legal/finance preference is to keep invoicing and settlement off the MSA (handled by a short pass-through addendum) to avoid changing revenue recognition terms in the MSA.
- Signer roles I suggest: 
   • MSA: Laura (GC) or proxy
   • Partner Paper / Marketplace Addendum: Marissa (VP Partnerships) + Rishi (Finance) for billing acceptance
   • Technical attestation / KMS evidence: Security (we can provide screenshots, not full keys)

Attachments (stubs): billing_flow_diagram.png, orderform_template.pdf

Ben
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudmarket.com>
Date: 2026-07-20 09:26 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMarket partner paper v3 + signer matrix

Team / Sophie —

Quick alignment:
- Timeline: we can provisionally sign the addendum by 7/22 if legal confirms wording. That will give platform ops a day to verify listing metadata before 7/24.
- Outstanding asks for CloudMarket: SOC2 attestation (redacted), KMS key ownership note, and a draft invoicing sample showing the pass-through line items. Sophie — can CloudMarket accept redacted SOC2 and a one-page KMS attestation instead of full artifacts?
- Laura — please highlight any residual MSA risk items (indemnity, escrow trigger language) we should push back on.

If legal is comfortable, I’ll assemble the DocuSign envelope with the signer matrix Ben suggested.

Marissa
VP Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudmarket.com>, CloudMarket Legal <legal@cloudmarket.com>
Date: 2026-07-21 16:42 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMarket partner paper v3 + signer matrix (redlines attached)

All —

Reviewed CloudMarket_PartnerPaper_v3 and our internal risk. Summary and attachments:

- Legal position on pass-through language: Acceptable with two clarifications: (1) define 'pass-through fees' as amounts invoiced to end-customers that are remitted to reseller, and (2) include a limited audit scope clause that covers invoicing and settlement records only (no broad platform access).
- Indemnity: we push to keep Redwood's indemnity carveouts intact; redline included.
- Escrow / audit trigger: keep as-is but add a 30-day remediation period before audit escalation.

Attachments (stubs): redlines_partnerpaper_v3.docx, signer_matrix_approved.xlsx

Evidence provided to CloudMarket (shared links):
- SOC2 (redacted report): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1soc2-redacted
- KMS attestation (screenshot + note): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kms-attest
- Invoicing sample (one-page): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1invoice-sample

Marissa — you have our go-ahead to prepare the DocuSign envelope with the following signers: Marissa Cole (Partner Addendum), Rishi Malhotra (Finance acknowledgement), Laura Bennett (MSA counsel sign-off as needed).

Sophie — once you confirm CloudMarket accepts redacted SOC2 + KMS attestation and the limited audit scope, we will route for signatures. Targeting signature completion by 7/23.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
General Counsel
Redwood Inference
snippet: Signer matrix and evidence for pass-through billing; legal confirms limited audit scope and approves DocuSign routing
